name: RoGUENeRF
aliases: RoGUENeRF: A Robust Geometry-Consistent Universal Enhancer for NeRF
definition: A geometry-consistent neural rendering enhancer that improves the visual quality and fidelity of rendered NeRF images while maintaining view-consistency and robustness to inaccurate camera calibration.
summary: RoGUENeRF is a lightweight post-processing enhancer for NeRF that improves visual fidelity and restores high-frequency textures using a geometry-aware alignment and fusion pipeline, avoiding the need for extensive re-optimization or large-scale synthetic pre-training datasets.
